title: Correct service event
purpose: Replace the values of a service event that was recorded wrongly, or withdraw it, keeping the original visible.

sections.title: Who can use it and when
paragraphs: The person who recorded the event, and managers and administrators; anyone else is refused, and viewers cannot open it. When the action is not possible right now, the form opens with a Not available notice that gives the reason, its fields are disabled and there is no submit button; Cancel returns to the record. The checks are repeated on the server when you save, so a form that opens is not a guarantee. An event that was already corrected must be corrected through the newer entry, and a withdrawn event cannot be corrected: record a new one.
The top of the form shows the equipment, the event and who recorded it and when.

sections.title: Fields
paragraphs: Entries are never edited or deleted. A correction adds a new entry that replaces the values of the old one, or withdraws it, and it always needs a reason; the original stays visible in the log marked Corrected and the new one is marked Correction (or Withdrawal). The kind cannot change.

items.label: Withdraw this event
items.description: Tick it when the event was recorded in error and should no longer count. The values below are then ignored.

items.label: Reason for the correction
items.description: Required, up to 4,000 characters. Do not enter donor, patient or participant names or other text that could identify a person.

items.label: Event fields
items.description: The same fields as Record service event (Performed on, Outcome, Performed by, Reference, Description, Reference device, As found, As left, Next due) start with the current values; change what is wrong.

items.label: Replace the attachment
items.description: Optional new file (PDF, PNG, JPEG, TXT or CSV, up to 10 MiB). Leave empty to keep the current file. The file is stored once: a correction that keeps it refers to the same stored file rather than a copy, and the earlier entry keeps showing its own file. If the repository has set a limit on the total size of attached files and it would be exceeded, the file is refused and nothing is recorded.

sections.title: Saving
paragraphs: Submitting with no value changed and no new file is refused with Nothing to correct. A correction takes effect for the due dates at once: the current due date comes from the latest effective event, so a corrected or withdrawn event changes what Maintenance due shows. Correct and the original, with its reason, both remain in the equipment record and in the audit trail.
